messages:
Maria G.: Heads up — we need benchmark visuals for next week's hosted launch. Hero graphic + two comparison charts + webinar slide templates. Brand must be locked. Can design take this?
Alex D.: On it. Can you confirm dataset/bench numbers? Also need example CTA and size specs. cc @design-bot for checklist.
Maria G.: Bench numbers: latency avg and p95 for three models (open, redwood-small, redwood-large). Also cost-per-1k tokens. I'll drop a CSV in the thread in a sec.
Sam R.: Landing CTA: 'See the latency breakdown' and 'Try a live demo' — prefer primary CTAs for hero. Metrics to highlight: 40% lower p95, 2x throughput. Also want social card 1200x630.
Alex D.: Got it. Quick specs:
```json
{"hero": {"size":"1600x900","format":"png/svg"}, "card":"1200x630"}
```
Will draft comps by EOD Thursday. Need brand kit assets and logo vectors.
Leo P.: For webinar we need: title slide, 3-data slides, 1-CTA slide, thumbnail for Zoom and YouTube. Theme: 'Performance & Price: Serving LLMs in Prod'. Speaker headshots attached in drive: https://figma.com/example (placeholder).
Maria G.: Brand compliance: use primary redwood palette, accessible color contrast (AA), no altered logo spacing. @Alex D. — follow brand tokens in /brand/kit: https://redwood.design/brandkit
 design-bot: Checklist: assets (hero, 2 charts, social card, webinar slides, thumbnails), formats (svg, png @2x), fonts (Inter variable), export naming convention: product_launch_bench_{asset}_{variant}.png
Alex D.: Small Q: For charts, do we want absolute numbers or normalized index? Normalized index easier for small labels. I'll post two mockups.
Sam R.: Normalized + callout with absolute numbers in tooltip. Also include a small legend: latency (p95 ms), cost ($/1k).
Maria G.: Timeline: comps Thu EOD -> review Fri morning -> final assets Mon morning. If design can't make Monday, push the webinar by a week. Thanks!
Alex D.: Ack. Will post initial mockups in #design-reviews and ping here. :thumbsup:
